title: Hearing on city's non-police violence prevention office
summary: The Council held a joint oversight hearing examining the Mayor's new Office of Community Safety, created by Executive Order 15 in March 2026 to coordinate crime prevention, victim services and mental health programs. The hearing also covered three bills: one to create a permanent Department of Community Safety, one to create a three-digit gun violence intervention hotline, and one to let people do community service instead of paying fines for illegal dumping near buildings.
